taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

allometry.note: 5 m at 30 years in the open, within Cheeseman's 3-7.6 m. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

traits.life_span.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: a closely branched shrub or small tree.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman does not say.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: 10-25 ft (3-7.6 m) high.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), just above Cheeseman's 25 ft.

traits.stem_diameter_max_m.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: a trunk 6-12 in (15-30 cm) across.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: leaves 1-2 in (2.5-5 cm) long with the petiole.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman gives no width.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: leaves obovate-oblong to elliptic-oblong or linear-oblong, obtuse or acute.

traits.inflorescence.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: spikes laxly branched like a raceme, the female more slender and less divided.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman gives no length for this species.

traits.flower_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman gives no colour; green as the authors render it.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman had not seen ripe fruit.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman had not seen ripe fruit.

traits.flowering_months.note: Cheeseman (1925), Manual of the New Zealand Flora pp. 371-372, Ascarina lucida: flowers September-November.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as Cheeseman had not seen ripe fruit.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (Chloranthaceae, 2026-10-16): sizes and looks stated as facts from Cheeseman's Manual and drawn by the decurrent tree defaults and the angiosperm rules; leaf width, months, spike length and fruit from the species-facts estimates.
